note: The launchd services on a fleet Mac that glaeda does not install but that have an owner: each label names the installer that puts it there and why it runs. glaeda-mini-health reports every other fleet-looking service (a label in match, or one naming a runner, worker or builder) in ~/Library/LaunchAgents, /Library/LaunchAgents or /Library/LaunchDaemons as unmanaged_service, a warning it never repairs: it never unloads, boots out or deletes anything. Leo, 2026-10-27: "why the fuck not manage it with glaeda????????" (rulebook: every fleet runner is glaeda-managed; no hand-made runner services). A service that starts a GitHub runner is runner_unmanaged's, not this list's. To add one: name its installer (a repo path) and its reason; a hand-made service has no installer and stays reported until glaeda or a declared installer owns it.
